reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it directly promotes time-limited OneCoin packages and upgrades, presenting coin transfers and access to mining and trading while urging members to act before the offers expire. It also recruits participation through a business hierarchy by telling members to bring prospects, motivate others, accumulate package codes, and pursue rank-linked benefits. The supplied material does not show a completed loss, but it clearly contains an active package-purchase and recruitment solicitation.

citations.quote: The 555 limited package is a time-limited offer
This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education and gives extended rights in the OneCoin platform to practice, mine, and trade.
Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen.
a great way to drive your business is by collecting free package codes, codes that you can use yourself or utilize to motivate others in your business.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not present every purchase as irrevocable or every benefit as unconditional. He states a cancellation right for Japanese starter-package purchasers and immediately limits that right to the starter package. He also describes the extra split as conditional on a specified upgrade by a specified date. Those qualifications matter: the video gives members terms they can evaluate, rather than promising that any purchase will produce a guaranteed financial return. The package pitch is promotional, but promotion with stated limits is not, by itself, evidence of deception.

citations.quote: All Japanese members will still have a 20 day cancellation right after purchasing the package. The cancellation period is valid only for the starter package.
If you upgrade to an Infinity Package from Tycoon, Premium or Festival by June the 5th 2016 you'll get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening correctly identifies a limited offer, package benefits and an invitation to bring prospects. But those quotes establish solicitation, not a false promise or a concealed condition. The speaker expressly confines the stated cancellation right to starter packages. Likewise, using package codes to motivate others does not, without more, establish that members are paid for recruiting them. The concern is understandable, but the cited language does not complete that inference.

citations.quote: The cancellation period is valid only for the starter package.
codes that you can use yourself or utilize to motivate others in your business.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A narrow cancellation right for Japanese starter-package purchasers does not qualify the broader upgrade solicitation. The speaker urges members to upgrade immediately, and separately tells them to bring prospects. The conditional extra split is an incentive to buy a higher package, not a warning about the risks of doing so. No completed loss is needed to recognize the active package-and-recruitment pitch.

citations.quote: The cancellation period is valid only for the starter package.
Visit your back office and upgrade your package now.
Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen.

opening.argument: Judge, this is also a member briefing about how the platform works. The speaker locates a Split Calculator in the back office and explains that members can use it to compare the splits associated with package upgrades. He then walks through where to check the bonus section. The package is described as including access to financial education, while the presentation also covers member support in several languages. Read as an operational webinar, these passages give existing members information about tools, benefits and support; they do not demonstrate that a viewer earns income by recruiting someone.

citations.quote: Following extensive work we are proud to introduce the Split Calculator. It is located in the bottom right-hand corner of your back office.
and then you go to the bonus section. It's here on the left side, where you can check how many splits he or she will receive
This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education
you can now send in your questions and have them answered in German, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing opening isolates the limited offer and the phrase about bringing prospects, but it leaves out the calculator walkthrough and the practical explanation of where members check splits. Even the quoted access to mining and trading is presented as platform functionality bundled with education, not as proof of an achieved return. The presence of promotion in a member briefing does not make every operational explanation a recruitment pitch.

citations.quote: This amazing tool gives you the chance to calculate the precise number of splits you will receive with each different package upgrade
This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education and gives extended rights in the OneCoin platform to practice, mine, and trade.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The calculator explanation reinforces the solicitation: its stated purpose is to compare package upgrades and help members choose the option yielding the most coins. The webinar does not stop at explaining a tool. It tells members to upgrade now, describes package codes as a way to drive their business and urges them to bring prospects. Educational access and support information do not erase those direct calls to expand participation.

opening.argument: Judge, the clearest reward examples have ordinary promotional readings. Event tickets have stated prices, a buy-ten-get-one-free offer and a rank-based ticket benefit. The package-code offer similarly specifies how many codes qualify for a free code. These are concrete purchase and loyalty terms. The cited material does not say that bringing a prospect earns a commission, identify a downline payment formula, request credentials or guarantee a financial return. Those omissions matter when deciding whether these observed rewards establish a recruitment-income scheme, rather than promotions to an existing membership.

citations.quote: There are three ticket categories bronze at 100 euros silver at 150 euros and gold at 200 euros.
If you buy 10 tickets from the same category, you can get one free.
we're giving all members with Diamond rank and above two free tickets for the event.
If you bank 8 Infinity codes, you'll get 1 Infinity code free If you bank 10 Premium codes, you'll get 1 Premium code free

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing side's prospect and package-code quotes warrant scrutiny, but neither specifies a commission paid for recruiting another person. The code terms describe a free code after a stated number have been banked; the ticket terms describe a familiar volume discount and an event perk. Calling the entire presentation a recruitment structure requires an inference beyond those specific reward terms, even though the speaker plainly promotes participation.

citations.quote: If you bank 10 Premium codes, you'll get 1 Premium code free
If you buy 10 tickets from the same category, you can get one free.
Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The ticket discount alone would not establish the case. But the speaker links package-code accumulation to driving members' businesses and motivating others, explicitly asks them to bring prospects, and urges package upgrades. A missing commission formula does not turn that combined purchase-and-recruitment solicitation into an ordinary ticket promotion. The defense's examples describe some peripheral benefits while leaving the central business pitch unanswered.
